instruction: Apply a header containing 'LibreOffice' to all pages within the current document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to insert a header containing the text 'LibreOffice' in all pages. The evaluator checks if the header contains this text (case-insensitive). The custom getter extracts header text from the DOCX file, and the custom metric verifies the expected text is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: All pages must have header containing 'LibreOffice'

Getter logic is correct: Iterates through ALL sections in the DOCX file (getters/docs.py:36), extracts header text from each section, and returns single header if all sections match or pipe-separated headers if they differ (lines 48-54)

Metric logic is correct: Properly handles both single and multi-section cases. When headers differ (contain ' | '), splits them and verifies EACH header contains expected text (metrics/docs.py:27-35), returning 1.0 only if ALL headers pass
Parameter handling is correct: Metric uses expected.get('text') for type='rule', correctly accessing the rules dictionary directly (line 15)
Postconfig is appropriate: Saves document with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure latest state is persisted
Edge cases handled: Returns 0.0 for empty headers, missing expected text, and when any section lacks required text
Case-insensitive comparison: Uses .lower() for text matching (lines 31, 38), allowing flexible verification
Complete coverage: Verifies ALL sections/pages, not just the first page
